mapper.select: SELECT productIdx, title, content, price, p.userIdx, hitCount, likeCount, chatCount, tradeType, tradeStatus, tradePlace, p.regionIdx, productStatus, pullCount, lastUpDate, p.createdDate, p.updatedDate, categoryIdx, u.nickName FROM product p JOIN users u ON p.userIdx = u.userIdx WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
SELECT productIdx, imgOrder, originalName, saveName, imgUrl FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx} ORDER BY imgOrder ASC
SELECT t.tagName FROM productTag p JOIN tag t ON p.tagIdx = t.tagIdx WHERE p.productIdx = #{productIdx}
SELECT tagIdx FROM tag WHERE tagName = #{tagName}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, price = #{price}, tradeType = #{tradeType}, tradePlace = #{tradePlace}, productStatus = #{productStatus}, categoryIdx = #{categoryIdx}, updateDate = SYSDATE WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
UPDATE product SET tagIdx = #{tagIdx} WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx} AND imgOrder = #{imgOrder}
